description: Create a lookalike audience from a first-party (customer list) seed segment. Creates an audience only, nothing is delivered. Previews unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

name.description: Name to give the new item. Shown in Ads Manager.

retention_days.description: How many days a person stays in the audience after the event (1 to 180).

seed_segment_id.description: Id of the audience to copy (the seed). Get it from snap_list_segments.

type.description: Filter by type (see the tool description for the choices).

name: snap_create_lookalike
